title: Conduvera GatePlan (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Deterministic gate execution plan for one candidate. DETERMINISM RULES (frozen): (1) every request carries a phase from the fixed P0-P5 order (P0 integrity/identity/fence/freshness, P1 governance/SSoT/scope/secrets/syntax/cheap boundaries, P2 affected lint/types/focused tests - independent items may run in parallel, P3 required full suites/integration/builds/migrations, P4 heavy/external analysis, P5 conditional semantic review); (2) requests MUST be sorted ascending by (phase_rank, execution_key); (3) execution keys are unique within the plan; (4) depends_on references only keys in the same plan and MUST be acyclic; (5) plan_digest is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 compact JSON (separators ',' ':' , sort_keys per object) of the `requests` array in stored order. A plan is pure planning data: it never carries outcomes, results, or merge decisions.

plan_digest.description: Content binding of the requests array in stored order (see DETERMINISM RULES).
